title: Real SWAP + live MODFLOW6 end-to-end application qualification
goal: Qualify one drainage-free single-column real FMR/SWAP application coupled end-to-end to live MODFLOW6 6.8.0 through the admitted predictor/corrector and publication lifecycle.
reconcile_findings: The real FMR groundwater-head forcing materializer is already admitted and restricted to bottom_mode=5.
F-GC30 already qualified a real FMR accepted-trajectory predictor/tangent path from a committed SWAP origin.
F-GC43 now supplies real kernel checkpoint/candidate/rollback/commit participant semantics.
The live MODFLOW6 prepared-solve/timestep backend is already qualified by F-GC38/F-GC41.

The remaining composition gap is executable same-process binding: fmr_serialized_reference_backend_t owns its kernel_executor_t privately, so F-GC43 cannot yet drive that exact bound production model through the backend without a narrow delegation seam.
No existing general SWAP/FMR C bridge was found; the only current C-bridge pattern is the MODFLOW-facing F-GC34 bridge.
design_decision: Do not expose the FMR backend's private kernel/model.
Add only narrow FMR backend delegation methods that prepare the restricted plain-water application context and invoke the admitted F-GC43 participant with the backend-owned kernel.
For the end-to-end fixture, use a narrow test-only/adapter C ABI around one qualified FMR application column so Python can drive real SWAP and live xmipy/MODFLOW in one process.
Use the admitted F-GC30 analytic predictor response; no runtime finite-difference fallback.
Keep the first F-GC44 envelope drainage-free, root-uptake-off, macropore-off, optional-state-off, single SWAP column to one MODFLOW cell.
invariants: Predictor/corrector ownership remains in the internal coupling service below iMOD Coupler.
Every prescribed-head SWAP corrector starts from one captured accepted checkpoint.
MODFLOW XOLD remains the accepted previous-time head throughout the prepared solve.
Coupled convergence requires both MODFLOW convergence and SWAP/MODFLOW interface-flux convergence.
All publication preflights pass before finalize_time_step.
Kernel commit remains the sole SWAP committed-state mutation.
No N:1 scaling expansion, Ribasim, irrigation or new groundwater physics.
next_permitted_action: Implement the narrow FMR-to-F-GC43 delegation seam, qualify it with real FMR physics first, then expose only the minimum C ABI needed for a live Python xmipy end-to-end application harness.
